BiblicalUsage: Isaiah pictures the Lord planting a vineyard on a fruitful hill, digging it, gathering out the stones, and planting it with the choicest vine. The word is that digging over — the hard work of clearing ground for planting.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God digs his vineyard with care before he plants it, and that tells me he does the same hard groundwork in my life.
